exposure: uterine rupture during trial of labor after cesarean
Patients with a previous cesarean section
outcome: Uterine rupture during trial of labor after cesarean
cohort: 6 patients with a previous cesarean section and 5 patients without a scarred uterus
finding: The study found no significant differences in EHG propagation characteristics between patients with and without a scarred uterus, suggesting that EHG changes might only occur in case of rupture.
